hook: Travel to any year from 1928 and ride real returns forward with your mix of stocks, bonds, cash and gold. See what time, inflation, fees and a bad start year really do. Educational only, not advice.
outcome: Explain risk and return, diversification, time horizon, inflation and fees using historical returns
sources: Annual returns 1928-2025 for the S&P 500, 10-year Treasury bonds, 3-month Treasury bills and gold: Aswath Damodaran, NYU Stern (January 2026 update)
Inflation: US CPI-U, December to December (BLS, via FRED series CPIAUCNS)
Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
